name: onepipeline-lint-llm
//: The judged diff lint's own project, holding `lint-llm-diff` and nothing else. That target hashes the whole workspace, and Nx counts a target's inputs when it decides what a change affects, so whichever project owns it is affected by every change: on the crate's own project it reached every Rust tier through the crate's `test`, whatever a pull request touched. Exempt from the uniform target set for that reason (npm/test/workspace-nx.test.mjs): a `test` here would run on every pull request and check nothing.
